title: Design System: 橘伴 Desktop AI Pet

send-orange.purpose: Legacy reference appearance only; current companion uses a pale apricot action with a dark cocoa foreground.

title.purpose: 圆润面板标题15px/600；亲切空态16px/600。

label.purpose: 作者名、时间戳、工具条、计数。

shadows.name: companion-shadow-panel
shadows.purpose: 话泡轮廓的轻投影；主体与角只投影一次，须完整留在原生绘制边界内。

motion.name: duration
motion.purpose: Shared interaction rhythm; reduced motion disables spatial movement

companionExperience.expression: One preloaded raster source through matching luminance mask; no companion vector eyelid patches.
companionExperience.fontFamily: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "PingFang SC", sans-serif

layout.titlebar: Current view title, independent settings, expand/collapse reading, close
layout.selection: Committed current page is idempotent; selecting it cancels a different queued destination and retains current dimensions
layout.composer: Cream20px writing surface, cocoa text, apricot send; truthful connection explanation near input
layout.memoCreation: Explicit inline expandable editor; closing preserves unsent draft
layout.reminderSync: Compact inspectable summary; due actions and all errors preserved
layout.navigationStyle: Separate icon-and-label soft capsules; apricot selected surface

companionExperience.visualAuthority: User rejected graphite tool styling; the accepted cat determines cream/apricot/cocoa palette and cute rounded character.

brandMark.style: Original filled cream/apricot paw; three toes; small inline header mark without square tile

panelAttachment.kind: clear rounded speech corner in one body-and-corner silhouette
panelAttachment.nativeAnchor: PanelViewport.petAnchor, logical chat coordinates; source point 530,390 on frozen 1207x1303 art
panelAttachment.fallback: No valid anchor: retain prior placement and omit decoration
panelAttachment.reveal: 180ms cat-facing origin, at most 8px/.985; reduced motion removes spatial movement
panelAttachment.paint: one closed SVG; fine apricot edge and one small 0 3px 4px warm shadow, alpha .10
panelAttachment.nativeGeometryChange: Chat horizontal spacing only; cat and backing dimensions preserved

components.name: Send Button
components.description: 杏橘色圆润发送键，深可可图标保持对比度。
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="发送消息"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7M12 5v14"/></svg></button>

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: 32px圆润轻量控件；hover浅杏，清楚暖棕焦点。
components.html: <button class="ds-icon" type="button" aria-label="设置"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/><path d="M12 2v3m0 14v3M2 12h3m14 0h3M5 5l2 2m10 10 2 2M19 5l-2 2M7 17l-2 2"/></svg></button>

components.name: Quick Prompt Chip
components.description: Legacy/reference example. 快捷提问：单一暖白表面、10px 圆角；输入建议但不自动发送。
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 5px 12px; color: #493b31; background: #fffefb; border: 1px solid #eadfd4; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-chip:hover { color: #a45831; border-color: rgba(172, 144, 122, 0.45); background: #f7f1e9; } .ds-chip:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45831; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 14px清楚输入；聊天20px圆角奶油书写面。
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="记录一项待办…" />

components.name: Assistant Bubble
components.description: 助手消息直接排在阅读面上，不再嵌套卡片。
components.html: 好的，我看了看你的待办列表，周五之前有三件事。

components.name: Pin Badge
components.description: Legacy/reference example. 置顶状态徽章：纯指示器，不是按钮。
components.css: .ds-pin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 26px; height: 26px; color: #96755a; background: rgba(255, 241, 226, 0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(203, 168, 136, 0.5); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85); }

narrative.northStar: 和奶油白猫一起住在桌面上的温暖小伙伴
narrative.overview: 用户已接受猫本身，冻结素材、表情与动作；明确否定石墨灰工具风格。按钮与面板延伸猫的奶油白、浅杏橘、暖可可色及圆润气质，保留已验证的导航、阅读、草稿和真实状态。
keyCharacteristics: 已批准白猫外观与行为冻结
奶油白与杏橘控件和猫同色系，暖可可文字可读
圆润标题、胶囊导航、柔软输入与亲切空态
稳定聊天/待办/备忘录导航，设置独立
离线与错误真实表达，不伪造内容

rules.name: Cat-matched warmth
rules.body: 色温、轮廓和按钮触感统一呼应白猫；不回到灰色效率工具外观。

rules.name: System typography
rules.body: 圆润系统字体，15px/600面板标题，14px/400正文，13px导航，12px说明。

rules.name: One elevation
rules.body: 只有面板与猫操作条使用各自共享柔和投影。

rules.name: Visible focus
rules.body: 轻量控件仍保留清楚的2px键盘焦点。

dos: 保留原始白猫资源，使用可溯源的派生独立素材
短句在紧凑面板完成，长文明确展开
状态与恢复动作清楚可读
只让猫表达局部动作，面板不呼吸
donts: 不擅自更换白猫身份或显示第二只猫
不强制完整合成图和连续底盘
不用假连接状态或假模型回复
不给控件逐项使用彩虹色或回弹动画
不用炭黑主按钮、绿灰表面或黑色下划线导航替代可爱/Q要求
